assets.role: Flat geometric vector logo for README and docs
Multi-resolution (16..256px) Windows icon embedded via src/gui/app.rc

modules.summary: Domain models, format detection (magic bytes + extension), Zip-Slip guard, wildcard matching, portable timestamps, and file I/O.
Header-only little-endian binary serialization and generic .partN.<ext> multi-volume reassembler.
Self-contained cryptographic primitives including AES-256-GCM, AE-2 SHA-1/CTR, ZipCrypto, SHA-256, CRC32, and OS CSPRNG.
RFC 1951 Deflate (Dynamic Huffman + Fixed Huffman + Stored auto-selection + lazy LZ77) and 9-bit O(1) Inflate + RFC 1952 GZip.
512-byte sector CRC32 + interleaved XOR parity Recovery Record builder and bit-for-bit burst-error repair engine.
Zero-dependency UTF-8 localization engine supporting 13 languages (en, zh, es, hi, ar, pt, id, fr, ja, ru, sr, hr, bs) with automatic Windows/POSIX OS locale detection.
Native OpenRaR (.orar) format: solid & parallel compression, AES-256-GCM payload & header encryption (-hp), Recovery Records (-rr), split volumes, comments, CRC32+SHA-256.
PKWARE ZIP & ZIP64 (>4GB / >65535 files), parallel compression, standard AE-2 AES-256 & ZipCrypto, UTF-8, comments, add/delete, header-scan repair, split volumes.
POSIX USTAR + GNU LongName .tar and .tar.gz/.tgz archive handler.
Zero-dependency binary header & entry parser for RAR4 and RAR5 archives.
Silent libarchive (Windows 11 tar.exe / Linux bsdtar) + unrar/7z fallback backend for RAR4/RAR5, 7z (create+extract), TAR.XZ, TAR.BZ2, TAR.ZST, CAB, ISO.
Unified API dispatching to format handlers + Batch Convert, Find-in-Archives, SFX builder, Multi-threaded Benchmark, HKCU Windows Explorer right-click integration.
Cross-platform CLI (openrar) supporting a, x, e, l, t, d, c, r, f, cv, sfx, b, info and switches -p, -hp, -m0..5, -s, -rr, -v, -o+/-o-/-or, -df, -t, -y.
Self-Extracting Archive executable stub reading ORARSFX1 trailer from its own binary.

Modular native Win32 desktop GUI with flat geometric embedded .ico, 9-button GDI+ toolbar, hierarchical archive browsing, right-click menu, Drag & Drop, non-blocking live progress dialog, Wizard, persistent config.
Cross-platform setup installers (Windows per-user PowerShell + Inno Setup 6, Linux/macOS install.sh + CPack DEB/TGZ) and automated multi-OS GitHub Release workflow.

Automated 11-suite verification & stress runner covering NIST/RFC6070 crypto, Deflate multi-block/fuzz, ZIP AE-2/ZipCrypto/Unicode/Repair/Split, OpenRaR Solid/Parallel/BurstRepair/Unicode/Split, Extract modes & Zip-Slip security, TAR GNU LongName, 7z/Convert/Find/Benchmark, RAR5 Inspector, real SFX execution, real CLI process, and 13-language i18n completeness.

invariants: openrar_core MUST remain 100% free of external third-party build dependencies so CMake builds offline on Windows and Linux.
All archive extraction paths MUST be validated with is_safe_relative_path() before writing to disk (Zip-Slip protection).
Never put Windows-only headers (<windows.h>) in public headers under include/openrar/.
Never block the Win32 UI thread for heavy compression/extraction; always wrap long operations in run_with_progress().
All compiler targets MUST build cleanly with zero warnings at /W4 (MSVC) and -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic (GCC/Clang).
Brand and visual assets MUST remain original and trademark-clean.
